data.name: Fast Grenade Throw
data.teaser: Brings back the classic instant grenade throw with dedicated key binds for overhand and underhand quick throws.
data.description:
Description

Brings back the classic instant grenade quick throw from earlier Tarkov patches. Press a key and your grenade flies — no equipping, no holding, no waiting.

Features

  • Instant overhand throw — one key press, grenade gone
  • Instant underhand throw — separate keybind for low trajectory tosses
  • Your normal grenade key is untouched — no conflicts with vanilla controls
  • Backpack, armband, and secure container support — finds grenades anywhere on you, not just your rig/pockets
  • Use Items Anywhere compatible — detects UIA and hooks into its slot system instead of conflicting with it

How it works

The mod uses the game’s built-in QuickGrenadeThrowHandsController — the same system BSG originally built for fast throws. It automatically finds the highest-priority grenade you’re carrying and throws it instantly, then returns you to your previous weapon.

Install Instructions
  1. Extract the archive
  2. Drop the BepInEx folder into your SPT root directory
  3. Launch the game — default keybinds are G (overhand) and H (underhand), configurable via F12

⚠️ Recommendation: If your normal grenade keybind is also G, change one of them to avoid conflicts. Either rebind your vanilla grenade key in-game, or change the quick throw key in the F12 config menu.

Known Limitations / Bugs
  • Conflicts with Janky’s Visual Assist: its Grenade Arc feature overrides the real throw with its own predicted trajectory, which can be stale during a quick throw. Symptom: the grenade appears to vanish, then explodes far away instead of where thrown. Workaround: disable “Grenade Arc” in Janky’s Visual Assist’s F12 settings.
Support

Found a bug or have a question? Leave a comment on this mod’s page, or reach out in my thread on the SPT Discord: https://discord.com/channels/875684761291599922/1521972310595338260

versions.description:
**Requires SPT 4.1.x.** This build will not load on 4.0.x — stay on [v1.0.4](https://github.com/Vultify/FastGrenadeThrow/releases/tag/v1.0.4) if you are still on 4.0.

### Changed
- Rebuilt against the deobfuscated SPT 4.1 client assemblies

### Fixed
- Grenade quick-slot icon showing a grenade that had already been thrown. The vanilla slot only tracks your rig and pockets, so throws and pickups involving the armband/belt or backpack left it stale until the next throw was already underway. It now always shows the grenade that will actually come out next, from any container.

### Install
Extract into your SPT root folder. Lands as `BepInEx/plugins/FastGrenadeThrow/FastGrenadeThrow.dll`.

- Fixed phantom grenade throws — the mod was using a broad inventory sweep that bypassed the game's own system, so grenades were thrown but never removed from inventory

- Fixed wrong grenade being selected — the same broad sweep returned grenades in an unpredictable order that didn't match the HUD, causing a different grenade to be thrown than the one displayed

- Added automatic **Use Items Anywhere** detection — without this both mods would fight over the same grenade selection code, potentially causing conflicts or one overriding the other

- Added debug logging toggle in F12 — there was previously no way to see what the mod was doing internally, making user-reported issues difficult to diagnose
Fixed Model 7290 Flash Bang releasing from waist level during quick throw. The flashbang now releases from hand height like all other grenades.

- Fixed weapon not returning after spamming throw key
- Fixed version display mismatch in F12 menu
- Includes all previous fixes (walking throw, modded equipment support)

- Fixed quick throw not working while walking (WASD movement)
- Grenades are now found in all equipment slots including modded belts and custom rigs
- Fixed potential double-trigger conflict
Initial release — brings back the OG instant grenade throw with dedicated overhand and underhand quick throw key binds. Configurable via F12.
